# Compute most common genre for each playlist
from collections import Counter

playlists = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_limit=20)
updates = []
for pl in playlists:
    genres = [song_genres[str(sid)] for sid in pl['song_ids']]
    counter = Counter(genres)
    most_common = counter.most_common(1)[0][0]
    new_title = f"{pl['title']} | {most_common}"
    updates.append((pl['playlist_id'], pl['title'], new_title))
    print(pl['playlist_id'], pl['title'], '->', new_title)
